about: Labelled retrieval questions per source. Documents: 'relevant' lists document ids; a hit is any chunk of a relevant document. kind: lexical (worded like the document) or paraphrase (the user's words). Incidents: 'topic' is the answer-key topic; a retrieved incident is relevant when its true topic matches. 'none' questions have no answer in any source and should fall below the gate.
